text:
michelle: Quick sync — Product asks to onboard `sparrow-small` (7B) into the catalog as a 'lightweight' entry. Proposal: a minimal bench + pin policy so sales can offer it to trial customers. Need scope decision by EOD Friday.

omar: What do you mean by 'minimal bench'? we can't ship without at least chat and embed slices.

michelle: Minimal = 1) chat gen quality on 200 prompt set (P0), 2) embed parity on 10k vectors sample, 3) perf smoke (99th token latency & cost). Not full perf-run.

jian: For perf smoke we need: p4d baseline, int8 and int4 quant runs, and KV cache disabled vs enabled. Can do a quick harness run in ~6h.

lisa: Research flagged a small drop vs existing 7B baseline on L2 for semantic search (~3%). Is that acceptable for trial customers?

kevin: Sales: a big enterprise customer asked to pin for 6 months if we can guarantee no MMR regressions. They want an escape clause.

ryan_cs: Customer impact: most SMBs won't notice 3% L2 change but enterprise SLAs care. If we allow 6m pin, we need a rollback & notification plan.

omar: Ops constraints: Dedicated pool capacity is limited. If we allow pinned traffic, need commit window + canary routing. Proposed: canary at 5% traffic for 7 days, then 25% for 7 days.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: bench-harness/sparrow-small-smoke -> queued (prio:high).

michelle: Good flags. Let's align on launch gates: 
- Bench: pass P0 quality (chat >= baseline - tolerated delta 5%), embed L2 <= 3% reg, perf smoke (99th token latency <= 80ms on p4d int8).
- Pin policy: default TTL 30 days; exceptions up to 6 months only with legal + CS signoff.
- Rollout: 5% x7d -> 25% x7d -> open.
- Metrics: automated weekly quality snapshot + alert on degradation > 2% L2 or avg latency +20%.

lisa: Can we add a quick A/B evaluation in the harness to capture hallucination rate on key intents? 30-min run.

jian: Yup, add hallucination probes. I'll queue tests.

kevin: For enterprise ask: we'll accept 3mo pin by default, 6mo needs exec signoff. Also want SLA wording for fallback (we'll auto-route to pinned model variant or fallback to Llama7b-v1).

omar: Technical note: fallback requires compatible tokenizer & schema. If customers use functions, we need to document differences.

michelle: Action items: Jian run smoke harness + hallucination probes (ETA: tomorrow noon), Omar draft rollout ops plan + canary routing config, Kevin draft customer pin term template, Lisa prepare quick quality note for PM comms. We'll reconvene Friday 10am to decide.

ryan_cs: Adding CS checklist: customer comm template, opt-in UI text, rollback support contacts.

michelle: Thanks — please add updates to the shared doc and tag me. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack.

omar: ack.

jian: starting runs now.

lisa: adding hallucination results to doc.

deploy-bot: bench-harness/sparrow-small-smoke -> started (run id: 2026-03-23-01).
